svg.title: Curved sections, zones and their bounds
svg.desc: The bend section and its partial no_overtaking zone use actual renderer geometry from curved_track.yaml. The gold band reveals the native curved zone selection region, which is invisible in the ordinary export. The slate section box and teal zone box are axis-aligned bounds computed from the road surface and zone selection vertices. Boxes, colors and labels are guide annotations; they are not exported semantic bounding-box fields. The exterior canvas is transparent.
